key.name: border-color
key.description: The color of the window borders in hexadecimal format.

key.name: rainbow
key.description: If true, the border color cycles through rainbow colors.

key.name: border-thickness
key.description: The thickness of the window borders in pixels (1-10).

key.name: border-radius
key.description: The radius of the window border corners in pixels (1-20).

key.name: color-morph
key.description: If true, enables color morphing effects on borders.
